comment: SKODA-608 source listing queries. Each renders `n` cards server-side (ajax_search_results_<type>=n). Items are merged by source id. Sized so the Peaq/Epiq rails fill (≥12 images each, all Peaq videos, all 9 Epiq videos) and a facet filter still leaves a load-more (>12) on both listings. Octavia (SKODA-208): the model page's Images/Videos rails show the 20 newest of each; 24 covers domain-restricted videos that are dropped. assetPages: URL lists whose pages link images from their copy (the model-page Liftback / Combi drawings); those become `asset` rows for the lightbox.
libraryComment: Types whose whole source media library is read (every year, through the listing load-more endpoint) and kept to the items whose original is published on AEM Assets (media-manifest public_url). Images only: the source video library is not in the DAM yet.

knownDetailGaps._comment: Rows the source itself has no detail for (verified with repeated live requests). The feed build fails on any other incomplete row. Re-verify and drop an entry when the source fills it.
